cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Keep Hope Operational
cards.instruction: Protect their hope with practical evidence and next steps while quietly withholding what makes the impossible outcome unlikely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your machine brought this note back from tomorrow. I've approved preparing a welcome for the visitor who sent it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The last live test killed the plant. May I read the new report before we set a place?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your request to prepare carefully is approved. Put the note beside the chair; someone in tomorrow knows your name.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're keeping the report under your hand. Can I see it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After you've written the welcome card. Use the name on that note. I'll keep the paperwork here; you've finally got someone to address it to.

reason: Supply the actual partial impossible success and an explicit adverse live test; A withholds the new report while directing a specific hopeful task using the successful note.
